title: Monday onboarding rush
story: A day's 1,300 placements compressed into business hours, with a 10x burst at 9am; workers and recruiters submit forms; every commit triggers a reconcile pull.
checked: P1 and P2 bars hold through the burst; no writer waits over 2 s.

witnesses.positive: placements onboarded during the rush (created, then Section 1 submitted)
witnesses.negative: placements onboarded in setup and never touched

reads: A reconcile pull at every returned receipt (as scenario 2) plus closed-loop pinned readers, 50% on subjects written in the previous 60 s (TARGETS 1.1 P1 item 1).

bars.source: TARGETS section 1 P1 and section 6 row 1
